message_1_subject: Action required: insurance evidence matrix + PO hold for BrightLynx onboarding
message_1_body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks for moving quickly on the onboarding. Procurement has the account in the queue but we are unable to issue a PO until we confirm the insurance evidence per our vendor risk matrix. To avoid activation delays please send the following: 

- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing Commercial General Liability (CGL) and Professional Liability limits (see matrix attached)
- Endorsement naming Redwood Inference as Additional Insured with waiver of subrogation and primary/non-contributory language
- Current W-9 (vendor tax form)
- Subcontractor disclosure if you use third-party subprocessors

I've attached our onboarding checklist and the evidence matrix for the limits and exact endorsement language we require. Important notes:
- Procurement will place a conditional PO (PO hold) for one billing cycle only when COI + W-9 are received; full activation requires the endorsement to exactly match the template we shared. 
- If you cannot provide the endorsement wording, please indicate which portions you propose to redline — we can escalate to Legal but that will add time.

Can you confirm ETA for the COI + W-9 today or tomorrow? If you have the COI but need the exact endorsement text, use the template at the link below and send a copy to procurement@redwood.com.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Vendor Ops – Procurement
Redwood Inference
n_sharma@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

---
redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (procurement checklist; see Insurance Evidence Matrix tab)
message_2_subject: Re: Action required: insurance evidence matrix + PO hold for BrightLynx onboarding
message_2_body:
Hi Nikhil —

Appreciate the note. We pulled our COI and a current W-9; our insurer issued the COI but they did not include the Additional Insured endorsement language you provided. A few quick points:

- COI: ready, will send after I confirm file naming.
- Endorsement: our broker says they can add Additional Insured and waive subrogation, but they will not accept 'primary/non-contributory' without a brief redline. They asked whether Redwood legal can accept the redline or if you require the exact template as is.
- W-9: we have a signed copy and will attach.

We are hoping to avoid escalation to Legal if possible — would Redwood accept a broker-issued endorsement that includes language equivalent to your template but with the small redline clause marked? If not, can you share a specific example of the unacceptable wording so we can get the broker to produce an exact match?

If you confirm procurement will issue a conditional PO upon receipt of the COI + W-9, we can proceed and aim to get the endorsement finalized within 48 hours.

Thanks,
Jordan Price
Head of Partnerships
BrightLynx Inc.
jordan.price@brightlynx.com | (917) 555-2093
message_3_subject: Re: Action required: insurance evidence matrix + PO hold for BrightLynx onboarding
message_3_body:
Jordan —

Thanks for the quick reply and for coordinating with your broker. Short answers:

1) Conditional PO: Procurement will issue a conditional PO (one month/initial invoice) once we have an electronic COI and the signed W-9. The PO will state 'activation conditional upon endorsement confirmation' and will be parked in our AP queue. Final release requires endorsement matching the template or an approved redline from Legal.

2) Redline process: If your broker cannot deliver an exact template, please send the proposed redline (PDF or screenshot) to lauren_bishop@redwood.com and I will route to Legal for a quick review. To keep timelines tight, ask the broker to call out the specific phrase they intend to change; omitted language vs alternative phrasing matters.

3) Acceptable workaround: If the broker can provide an endorsement that includes 'Additional Insured' + 'Waiver of Subrogation' and an explicit statement that coverage is primary to contractor's other insurance, we can often accept that while Legal reviews. However this depends on precise wording — send us the draft and we will triage.

Please attach the COI and W-9 to your reply and include the broker endorsement draft if available. I'll confirm when Procurement issues the conditional PO.

Appreciate the collaboration — we want to get you activated without unnecessary delay.

Nikhil

Attached: COI and W-9. Our broker also provided a draft endorsement which includes Additional Insured and Waiver of Subrogation; they redlined the primary/non-contributory sentence to read 'coverage will be primary to the extent permitted by law'. I've pasted the broker draft below for your review. If Legal confirms this is acceptable, can Procurement issue the conditional PO and provide a PO number so we can submit invoices?

"Additional Insured: Brightwood Inference, its officers, directors and employees are included as Additional Insured to the extent of liability arising out of the insured's operations performed on behalf of Brightwood Inference.
